g.text: No model is the point-estimate leader on every task
Current primary aggregates · tracked-artifact audit · 5-model common roster · metrics remain separate
Result: point-estimate leaders change by task. Compare-task intervals overlap pairwise, so those panels do not establish a model order.
Panel scales differ: compare models within a task, not vertical distance across tasks. Intervals omit route drift, contamination, construct error, and human validity.
